why: Bun 1.4.4's realpathSync no longer folds a segment spelled `\..` (a file name, not `..`) as if it were `..`: `/root//\..` is ENOENT there, where Bun 1.3.14 and 1.4.2 answered `/`. So the deny glob `/[\]..` (row 1139) now canonicalises to `/root/\..` (one slash) instead of being kept as typed; the same path either way to the kernel. The code did not change.
